items.invalidation: not applicable, pass. would only revisit if the same-symbol pools turned out unrelated, socials appeared, and holders grew past 1k with consistent data.

items.name: MONEYBIZ
items.thesis: 1h-old graduate that ran +1295% with +295% in the last hour, sitting 2% under its high, so this is a parabolic top and not a held retrace. Same-symbol pools exist (copy risk), creator bought first and has sold, 17 of 20 buys came in the first minute, and 30m volume is 0.53x the prior half hour.
items.invalidation: n/a (pass). would reconsider only after a 30-60% retrace that holds with higher lows, m5 buys leading, and age past ~2h.

items.name: PUNANI

items.invalidation: n/a (pass). would revisit if socials appear, the copy question resolves in its favor, and m5 buys lead on a held higher low after 3h of age.

items.name: UDTF

items.name: AOP
items.thesis: copy of a running ticker: three same-symbol pools, 12h old with 1.2m, 1.3m and 293k liquidity, versus this 1.5h pool at 33k. the reader shows 12 holders, top10 at 101% and dev at 80%, which clashes with the helius view. the launch had only 3 curve tx and 2 distinct early buyers. no socials, and the price sits at its 24h high after 3.8x off the low, so there is no held pullback to enter.
items.invalidation: n/a for a pass. it would only change if the bigger pools turned out to be unrelated, holders grew past 200 with a real x account, and the price held a pullback with m5 buys leading.

items.name: hexx
items.thesis: 1.5h graduate with sells > buys on 1h (1610 vs 1286) and 5m (68 vs 75 is close, but 1h and 6h both lean to sellers), and 30m volume at 0.59x. Wallet picture is only partly clean: 8 same-block bundle buys, 20/20 buys in the first minute, 11 distinct first-20 buyers, 33 holders (stale 1.8h), and three same-ticker pools exist, so copy risk is live.
items.invalidation: would reconsider if 1h buys flip above sells by 1.3x with 30m volume above 1x, holders grow past several hundred, and bundle supply is shown to be gone.

items.name: HELL
items.thesis: hard flaws everywhere: the dossier shows 18 holders with top10 at 100% and dev at 79%, which would trip the constitution veto, even though the helius wallet read looks clean and contradicts it. the 16,632% h6 move with 1,703 buys against 36 sells on 18 holders looks scripted, and a bigger 168h pool with the same ticker makes this a likely copy.
items.invalidation: n/a for pass. it would take holders in the hundreds, dev under 5% confirmed by two sources, and no older pool with the same name to change my mind.

items.name: LIFAS
items.thesis: a 43-minute pool with 4.8m of volume on a 115k fdv means the whole cap traded about 42 times in an hour, and liquidity reported above fdv makes the numbers unreliable. it has no socials, three other pools share the ticker (two of them older), and it sits 2% under its high after +120% in the hour with 5m flow back to near-even, so four confirmed killers are stacked: wash turnover, no socials, copy and chase.
items.invalidation: i am wrong if it holds above 1.0e-06 for 2h with real holder growth past 500, socials appear, the turnover falls to sane levels without price collapsing, and it outlasts the older same-ticker pools.

items.name: NODF

items.invalidation: n/a, pass. it would take a real distribution of holders (hundreds, not 13) and the original ticker losing its attention to reopen this.

items.name: LIFAS
items.thesis: lifas has three other pools with the same ticker. two are bigger on liquidity, and one with 140k liq and 1.9m volume is younger at 0.4h, so this looks like a copy of a running name, the most reliable trap in the ledger. flow is also fading: 30m volume is 0.38x the prior half hour, price is -27% in 5m, and holders are only 104 against a 60% top10 figure from the stale reader.
items.invalidation: would reconsider only if this pool proved to be the original ticker with the deepest liquidity, holders growing past 500, and m5 buys clearly above sells with volume re-accelerating.

items.invalidation: n/a (pass). would only revisit if the symbol collision turned out to be wrong and this pool became the main one with real socials.
